answer: The copper test I would run is Crowned silk spinner permit with silk workers attestation: a permit workers renew after reel audits, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. What the farm fears is not one hard check but a check that cannot be shared: a permit workers renew after reel audits is per-account by construction, and the vault is that the tenth clone costs as much as the first. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here. The ridge grows with every clone, but the reward per clone stays fixed, so the farm goes broke before it goes big.
